product_summary: People and company data provider offering enrichment, search, IP enrichment and data-license feeds built on a large person dataset and 70M+ company profiles, plus job-posting signals.
current_data_sources: Proprietary licensed data (HR Tech, Real Estate Tech, Identity/Anti-Fraud, Martech)
Publicly available data and open datasets

api_or_integration_evidence.quote: Our Company Enrichment API helps you retrieve unique insights from our company dataset.
License data feeds. Access via Snowflake & Databricks.

newsletter_capability_detail: Searched the Data Sources & Compliance doc, the Company Enrichment API page and the site for 'newsletter'. Sources are described only by category ('HR Tech, Real Estate Tech, Identity/Anti-Fraud, Martech'); no newsletter, publication or editorial-content dataset is documented.

evidence.quote: Our data sources come from a variety of verticals, including HR Tech, Real Estate Tech, Identity/Anti-Fraud, Martech and others.
Our Job Posting Dataset is sourced exclusively from company career pages
Access over 70MM+ company profiles, from stealth startups to conglomerates.

likely_buyer_role: Head of Data Partnerships or Product Manager, Company Data / Enrichment

contact_route.note: Public contact page offers a 'Submit a ticket' support form; no sales email published. Enterprise plans route via a dedicated CSM.

caveats: PDL documents sources only at category level and does not enumerate its web-scrape inputs, so newsletter absence is unverified rather than confirmed. They already sell a non-firmographic activity signal (job postings from career pages), which is the closest existing analogue and a useful wedge, but also means newsletter activity would compete with an in-house signal. No public newsletter dataset or partnership mention found.
